case.title: Walter: short of breath, again
case.disclaimer: Fictional teaching case written for HackPrinceton 2026. Not medical advice.
case.chief_complaint: Short of breath for 5 days; sleeping in his recliner

facts.label: 5 days of worsening breathlessness; now sleeps in his recliner
Both ankles swollen; shoes don't fit
Skips his water pill (furosemide) on bowling days, Tue and Thu
Wife Ayşe fills his pill box; she reads little English and speaks Turkish
SpO2 84% on room air on arrival
Chest X-ray: vascular congestion and right lower lobe infiltrate
Echo: EF about 30%, down from 40% last year

transcript.speaker: student
transcript.text: Hi Mr. Brennan, what brings you in today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Can't catch my breath for about five days. I've been sleeping in the recliner because lying flat feels like drowning.

transcript.speaker: student
transcript.text: Any swelling in your legs or ankles?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: My ankles look like somebody inflated them. Can't get my work boots on.

transcript.speaker: student
transcript.text: Do you take your water pill every day?

transcript.speaker: student
transcript.text: No judgment at all, a lot of people skip it. Do you ever miss the water pill?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Fine. I skip the water pill on bowling days. You try rolling a 200 game running to the john every ten minutes.

transcript.speaker: student
transcript.text: Who helps you with your pills at home?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Ayşe does the pill box every Sunday. Her English reading isn't great, so she goes by the color of the pills mostly.
